description:
*FREE GUIDE: 📘 The Content Creator's AI Blueprint*  – https://FirstMovers.ai/blueprint/

*I texted a phone number and 4 minutes later two flight confirmations hit my inbox. No app, no browser, no prompt. That's Instinct AI, and investors are about to value it at $10 billion.*

Instinct launched in February, sits at about 100,000 invite-only users, and ran from a $50M seed to a *$10B* valuation in roughly 5 months with zero revenue. Founder *Noah Shinn* is 23 and says he never wants to charge users.

What you'll learn:
✅ How one text thread *booked* my flights and sent my emails
✅ The $50M to $10B valuation ladder and the *200x* math
✅ Where it breaks: the Gmail data it keeps after you disconnect

Nobody has said out loud how a free agent reading your inbox makes *money*.
